name: starrypass-production
description: StarryPass v2.1 for production — bit-compatible with the original hand-rolled derivation, implemented entirely on mature, audited primitives (Web Crypto + @noble/hashes).
author: lingyicute

scripts.build: esbuild src/spv2-core.mjs --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js='/*! StarryPass v2 production core — AGPL-3.0 — bundles @noble/hashes + hash-wasm (both MIT), see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md */' --outfile=assets/js/spv2-core.js
scripts.test: node tests/verify_strength.mjs && node tests/verify_core.mjs && node tests/verify_sw.cjs && node tests/verify_spv2.mjs && node tests/verify_bundle.mjs
